note:
### Overwatch Retail Patch Notes - April 17, 2026

#### Balance Hotfix Update

This is a balance hotfix update. Replay codes from the April 14, 2026 patch are still available.

#### Damage

![Sierra](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/P2Fo/256X256/patch-2026-04-17-eee184f317-01-t.png)

##### Sierra

Sierra has not been as effective as intended since her launch. Her weapon damage is being increased to improve overall output, while the damage increase to Tracking Shot better rewards players for successfully landing it. The Anchor Drone changes improve mobility responsiveness and drone survivability, allowing for more aggressive playstyles. Sierra’s ultimate cost has also been increased due to its already fast charge rate in combination with her improved damage output.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/vCmx/128X128/patch-2026-04-17-eee184f317-02-t.png)

Trailblazer

* Ultimate cost increased by 30%.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/tFnn/388X103/patch-2026-04-17-eee184f317-03-t.png)

Helix Rifle

* Damage per projectile increased from 7 to 9.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/K2fe/128X128/patch-2026-04-17-eee184f317-04-t.png)

Tracking Shot

* Damage per projectile increased from 7 to 9.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/LOmt/128X128/patch-2026-04-17-eee184f317-05-t.png)

Anchor Drone

* Health increased from 30 to 80.
* Grapple move speed increased from 20 to 22.

Medi-Drone – Major Perk

* Healing increased from 75 to 100.
note_cn:
### 《守望先锋》正式服更新说明 - 2026年4月17日

#### 平衡性热修复更新

本次为平衡性热修复更新。2026年4月14日补丁的录像代码仍可使用。

#### 输出

![西拉](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/P2Fo/256X256/patch-2026-04-17-eee184f317-01-t.png)

##### 西拉

西拉自上线以来的表现未达预期。我们提高了她的武器伤害以提升整体输出，同时增加了追踪弹的伤害，从而更好地奖励成功命中的玩家。锚点无人机的改动提升了位移响应速度和无人机的生存能力，使其能够支持更具侵略性的玩法。由于伤害输出提升后终极技能的充能速度过快，我们也相应提高了西拉的终极技能消耗。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/tFnn/388X103/patch-2026-04-17-eee184f317-03-t.png)

开路先锋

* 终极技能消耗提高30%。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/tFnn/388X103/patch-2026-04-17-eee184f317-03-t.png)

螺旋步枪

* 每发子弹的伤害从7点提高至9点。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/K2fe/128X128/patch-2026-04-17-eee184f317-04-t.png)

追踪弹

* 每发子弹的伤害从7点提高至9点。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/LOmt/128X128/patch-2026-04-17-eee184f317-05-t.png)

锚点无人机

* 生命值从30点提高至80点。
* 抓钩移动速度从20提高至22。

医疗无人机 – 核心威能

* 治疗量从75点提高至100点。
